I can't set up a recurring 09:00 DM from here. I don't have a scheduling tool in this conversation, so nothing will arrive automatically tomorrow.

What I can do is put together a Coastal team digest whenever you ask, covering new activity in #coastal-team since your last one. Just message me "digest" and I'll pull it from the channel. If you need it truly automatic, someone with scheduling access will have to set up the daily job.
